<h3>1 · Videos</h3>Add the footage to le:
1 · Videos

Add the footage to learn from. It is cut into 5-second samples, and samples that look alike are put together in groups for the next step. One video is a fine start; for a model that works on new footage, each thing should appear in at least 3 videos.
<h3>2 · Groups</h3>Samples that look ali:
2 · Groups

Samples that look alike are shown together. For each group, click any tile that does not belong, then say what the rest show. Only the tiles you saw are labelled; the rest of each group is checked in step 4. Select tiles and use Move to put them anywhere; Show all lists a whole group.
<h3>3 · Browse</h3>Everything, like fold:
3 · Browse

Everything, like folders. Pick one on the left, select samples (Shift-click for a range), and move them where they belong. Double-click plays one.
<h3>4 · Check guesses</h3>What you named:
4 · Check guesses

What you named becomes the examples, and every other sample gets a guess. Check them a batch at a time: each tile already shows its guess, so click only the wrong ones and press Enter. After a class has 5 checked samples, its confident guesses are accepted for you, and a few of those come back as spot checks.

Points on seconds where a sampled frame: Pontos em segundos onde um quadro amostrado tem movimento (área de contraste acima do mínimo do detector). Não é um pico-então-quieto, é um pico de movimento.
Points on seconds with a local waveform: Pontos em segundos com um pico de onda local acima de -20 dB. Nem uma explosão de volume, que se compara a cada momento com seu próprio bairro.
Points on the second a scene cut starts: Pontos no segundo em que um corte começa (um salto na diferença de quadro). Um golpe por corte, não para o resto da cena.
Points when motion inside a scene rises: Pontos quando o movimento dentro de uma cena sobe acima da média dessa cena, então fica baixo por cerca de 4 segundos de amostras.
Points where the audio rises above its O:
